---
title: "64 -- NanoLuciferase GC3 Content and eIF3d Codon Preference Analysis (MDA-MB-231)"
author: "Kate Matlin"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
    code_folding: hide
editor_options:
  chunk_output_type: console
---

Analyzes GC3 content and synonymous codon usage of eIF3d hypoxia-promoted mRNAs
(MDA-MB-231, 1hr hypoxia, TE LFC > 0.5, padj < 0.05), then compares a NanoLuciferase
CDS to this profile and designs adapted and anti-adapted NanoLuc variants.

All RSCU values are background-corrected pooled bg-RSCU (Sharp and Li 1987 corpus
definition). For codon j encoding amino acid a:

  bg-RSCU(j) = [count(j) / count(a_total) in gene set] / [count(j) / count(a_total) in background]

Values > 1: codon is over-used relative to background. Values < 1: under-used.

Two backgrounds are compared:
- **Transcriptome-wide**: loaded from pre-computed `bg_rscu_pooled_231_hyp_vs_nor.csv`
  (produced by nb54, uses all expressed transcripts as background).
- **Negative controls**: genes with |TE LFC| < 0.5 and padj > 0.3 across all si3d
  conditions (recomputed here from the same CDS sequences).

Sequence design uses transcriptome-wide bg-RSCU as the primary ranking metric;
negative-control bg-RSCU is shown for comparison.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
```

# Section 1: Libraries and Parameters

```{r load_libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(GenomicFeatures)
library(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38)
library(Biostrings)
library(coRdon)
library(ggrepel)
library(patchwork)
```

```{r params}
lfc_cutoff  <- 0.5
padj_cutoff <- 0.05
n_boot      <- 1000
seed        <- 9
cat("Parameters: lfc_cutoff =", lfc_cutoff,
    "| padj_cutoff =", padj_cutoff,
    "| n_boot =", n_boot, "\n")
```

---

# Section 2: NanoLuc CDS Input

Paste the NanoLuc coding sequence from Benchling below (DNA, 5' to 3', without
stop codon or with stop codon -- the code handles both). Replace the placeholder
string with the actual sequence.

```{r nanoluc_input}
# ============================================================
# PASTE NANOLUC CDS HERE (raw DNA sequence, no spaces/newlines)
# ============================================================
nanoluc_cds_raw <- ""   # <-- replace with sequence from Benchling

# Validate input is non-empty
stopifnot("NanoLuc sequence is empty -- paste CDS in nanoluc_cds_raw" =
            nchar(nanoluc_cds_raw) > 0)
# Uppercase, strip whitespace
nanoluc_cds_raw <- toupper(gsub("\\s", "", nanoluc_cds_raw))

# Validate length
stopifnot("NanoLuc CDS length not divisible by 3" =
            nchar(nanoluc_cds_raw) %% 3 == 0)
cat("NanoLuc CDS length:", nchar(nanoluc_cds_raw), "nt\n")
```

```{r nanoluc_translate}
nanoluc_dna <- DNAString(nanoluc_cds_raw)
nanoluc_aa  <- as.character(translate(nanoluc_dna))

# Remove trailing stop codon if present (make sequence stop-codon-free for design steps)
has_stop <- endsWith(nanoluc_aa, "*")
if (has_stop) {
  nanoluc_aa_orf <- substr(nanoluc_aa, 1, nchar(nanoluc_aa) - 1)
  # Trim stop codon from DNA too
  nanoluc_cds_orf <- substr(nanoluc_cds_raw, 1, nchar(nanoluc_cds_raw) - 3)
  cat("Stop codon present and trimmed. ORF length:", nchar(nanoluc_cds_orf), "nt\n")
} else {
  nanoluc_aa_orf  <- nanoluc_aa
  nanoluc_cds_orf <- nanoluc_cds_raw
  cat("No trailing stop codon. ORF length:", nchar(nanoluc_cds_orf), "nt\n")
}

# No internal stop codons
stopifnot("Internal stop codon in NanoLuc ORF" =
            !grepl("\\*", nanoluc_aa_orf))
cat("NanoLuc protein length:", nchar(nanoluc_aa_orf), "aa\n")
cat("NanoLuc protein (first 20 aa):", substr(nanoluc_aa_orf, 1, 20), "\n")
```

```{r nanoluc_codons}
# Split ORF into codon vector (no stop)
nl_codon_vec <- substring(
  nanoluc_cds_orf,
  seq(1, nchar(nanoluc_cds_orf) - 2, 3),
  seq(3, nchar(nanoluc_cds_orf),     3)
)
stopifnot("Codon vector length mismatch" =
            length(nl_codon_vec) == nchar(nanoluc_cds_orf) / 3)
cat("NanoLuc codon count:", length(nl_codon_vec), "\n")

# Genetic code (needed here for AA translation of each codon)
gen_code     <- Biostrings::getGeneticCode("SGC0")
sense_codons <- names(gen_code[gen_code != "*"])
aa_to_codons <- split(sense_codons, gen_code[sense_codons])
multi_aa     <- sort(names(aa_to_codons)[sapply(aa_to_codons, length) > 1])
multi_syn_codons <- unlist(aa_to_codons[multi_aa], use.names = FALSE)

# All NanoLuc codons should be sense codons
stopifnot("Non-sense codon in NanoLuc ORF" =
            all(nl_codon_vec %in% sense_codons))
```

```{r nanoluc_gc3}
gc3_codons  <- sense_codons[substr(sense_codons, 3, 3) %in% c("G", "C")]
at3_codons  <- sense_codons[substr(sense_codons, 3, 3) %in% c("A", "T")]

nl_gc3_count <- sum(nl_codon_vec %in% gc3_codons)
nl_at3_count <- sum(nl_codon_vec %in% at3_codons)
nl_total_sense <- length(nl_codon_vec)

nanoluc_gc3 <- nl_gc3_count / nl_total_sense * 100

stopifnot("NanoLuc GC3 out of range [0,100]" =
            dplyr::between(nanoluc_gc3, 0, 100))
cat("NanoLuc GC3%:", round(nanoluc_gc3, 1),
    "(GC-ending codons:", nl_gc3_count, "of", nl_total_sense, ")\n")
```

# Section 3: Reference CDS Sequences and Codon Count Matrix

Follows the same approach as nb54. All expressed transcripts from
`feature_matrix_external_stability.rds` are used to build the codon count matrix.

```{r load_feature_matrix}
feature_matrix <- readRDS(
  here("output", "predictive_modeling", "feature_matrix_external_stability.rds")
)
keep_tx <- feature_matrix$transcript_id_clean
cat("Feature matrix:", nrow(feature_matrix), "genes\n")
```

```{r load_txdb}
txdb   <- loadDb(here("accessories", "human", "txdb.gencode49.sqlite"))
genome <- BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38

cds_all         <- cdsBy(txdb, by = "tx", use.names = TRUE)
cds_seqs_all    <- extractTranscriptSeqs(genome, cds_all)
cds_names_clean <- sub("\\..*", "", names(cds_seqs_all))
```

```{r select_hypoxia_transcripts}
# Load TE results to identify genes absent from the feature matrix
te_all <- read_csv(
  here("output", "translation_categories_si3d_vs_sictrl_hypoxia_1hr.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(gene_id_clean = sub("\\..*", "", gene_id))

missing_gene_ids <- te_all$gene_id_clean[
  !te_all$gene_id_clean %in% sub("\\..*", "", feature_matrix$gene_id)
]
cat("TE genes not in feature matrix:", length(missing_gene_ids), "\n")

# Tx-to-gene map from the same pre-built file used by nb01
tx_map <- read_tsv(
  here("accessories", "human", "tx2gene_hs_dm_v49_r111.tsv.gz"),
  col_names = c("transcript_id", "gene_id"),
  col_types = "cc"
) %>%
  filter(str_starts(transcript_id, "ENST")) %>%
  transmute(
    transcript_id_clean = sub("\\..*", "", transcript_id),
    gene_id_clean       = sub("\\..*", "", gene_id)
  )

# Mean TPM across 1hr hypoxia siCTRL replicates
hyp_samples <- c("NM2025_0094", "NM2025_0095", "NM2025_0096")
hyp_files   <- setNames(
  file.path(here("2025_MDAcells_riboseq", "salmon"), hyp_samples, "quant.sf.gz"),
  hyp_samples
)
stopifnot("Hypoxia siCTRL quant files missing" = all(file.exists(hyp_files)))

hyp_tpm <- map_dfr(names(hyp_files), function(s) {
  read_tsv(hyp_files[[s]], col_types = "cdddd",
           col_names = c("Name", "Length", "EffectiveLength", "TPM", "NumReads"),
           skip = 1) %>%
    dplyr::select(Name, TPM) %>%
    mutate(sample = s)
}) %>%
  group_by(Name) %>%
  summarise(mean_tpm = mean(TPM), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(transcript_id_clean = sub("\\..*", "", Name))

# For missing genes: pick highest mean-TPM protein-coding transcript (must have CDS in txdb)
cds_tx_clean <- unique(cds_names_clean)
extra_tx_df <- hyp_tpm %>%
  inner_join(tx_map, by = "transcript_id_clean") %>%
  filter(
    gene_id_clean %in% missing_gene_ids,
    mean_tpm > 0,
    transcript_id_clean %in% cds_tx_clean
  ) %>%
  group_by(gene_id_clean) %>%
  slice_max(mean_tpm, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

n_extra        <- nrow(extra_tx_df)
n_still_missing <- length(missing_gene_ids) - n_extra
cat("Extra transcripts selected from 1hr hypoxia siCTRL:", n_extra, "\n")
cat("Genes with zero hypoxia TPM (excluded):", n_still_missing, "\n")

keep_tx_expanded <- c(keep_tx, extra_tx_df$transcript_id_clean)
```

```{r build_cds}
keep_idx   <- cds_names_clean %in% keep_tx_expanded
cds_frame0 <- cds_seqs_all[keep_idx]
names(cds_frame0) <- cds_names_clean[keep_idx]

valid      <- width(cds_frame0) %% 3 == 0 & width(cds_frame0) > 0
cds_frame0 <- cds_frame0[valid]
cat("CDS sequences (frame 0, divisible by 3):", length(cds_frame0), "\n")
```

```{r codon_matrix}
ct0         <- codonTable(cds_frame0)
counts_mat0 <- codonCounts(ct0)
rownames(counts_mat0) <- names(cds_frame0)
cat("Codon counts matrix:", nrow(counts_mat0), "transcripts x", ncol(counts_mat0), "codons\n")
stopifnot("Zero-count rows in codon matrix" = all(rowSums(counts_mat0) > 0))

# Transcript-to-gene map (feature matrix + hypoxia-selected extras)
extra_tx_gene <- extra_tx_df %>%
  left_join(te_all %>% dplyr::select(gene_id, gene_id_clean) %>% distinct(),
            by = "gene_id_clean") %>%
  dplyr::select(transcript_id_clean, gene_id, gene_id_clean)

tx_to_gene <- bind_rows(
  feature_matrix %>%
    dplyr::select(transcript_id_clean, gene_id) %>%
    mutate(gene_id_clean = sub("\\..*", "", gene_id)),
  extra_tx_gene
)

tx_gene_df <- tibble(transcript_id_clean = rownames(counts_mat0)) %>%
  left_join(tx_to_gene, by = "transcript_id_clean")

# GC3 classification table
codon_gc3_tbl <- tibble(
  codon          = sense_codons,
  amino_acid     = gen_code[sense_codons],
  gc3_nucleotide = substr(sense_codons, 3, 3),
  gc3_class      = if_else(substr(sense_codons, 3, 3) %in% c("G", "C"),
                           "GC-ending", "AT-ending")
) %>% filter(amino_acid != "*")

aa_three_letter <- c(
  A = "Ala", C = "Cys", D = "Asp", E = "Glu", F = "Phe",
  G = "Gly", H = "His", I = "Ile", K = "Lys", L = "Leu",
  M = "Met", N = "Asn", P = "Pro", Q = "Gln", R = "Arg",
  S = "Ser", T = "Thr", V = "Val", W = "Trp", Y = "Tyr"
)
```

# Section 4: Gene Sets

```{r load_te_results}
# te_all was loaded in select_hypoxia_transcripts; alias here for clarity
te_hyp <- te_all
cat("Total genes in hypoxia TE results:", nrow(te_hyp), "\n")
```


```{r promoted_genes}
promotes <- te_hyp %>%
  filter(te_lfc > lfc_cutoff, te_padj < padj_cutoff)
cat("eIF3d hypoxia-promoted genes (TE LFC >", lfc_cutoff,
    ", padj <", padj_cutoff, "):", nrow(promotes), "\n")
stopifnot("Expected 1604 eIF3d hypoxia-promoted genes" = nrow(promotes) == 1604)

# Transcripts in codon matrix
promotes_tx <- tx_gene_df %>%
  filter(gene_id_clean %in% promotes$gene_id_clean) %>%
  pull(transcript_id_clean)
promotes_tx <- promotes_tx[promotes_tx %in% rownames(counts_mat0)]
n_promotes_found <- length(promotes_tx)
n_promotes_missing <- sum(!promotes$gene_id_clean %in% tx_gene_df$gene_id_clean)
cat("Promoted transcripts found in codon matrix:", n_promotes_found, "\n")
# Some promoted genes remain absent because no protein-coding isoform has
# detectable expression in 1hr hypoxia siCTRL RNA-seq (zero TPM for all
# CDS-bearing transcripts). These genes were also absent from the normoxia
# feature matrix, so they cannot be represented by any available transcript.
cat("Promoted genes still absent (zero TPM for all CDS isoforms in hypoxia):", n_promotes_missing, "\n")
stopifnot("Fewer than 90% of promoted genes found in codon matrix" =
            n_promotes_found > 0.90 * nrow(promotes))
```

```{r neg_control_genes}
neg_ctrl <- read_csv(
  here("output", "predictive_modeling", "negative_control_genes.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(gene_id_clean = sub("\\..*", "", gene_id))
cat("Negative control pool:", nrow(neg_ctrl), "genes\n")

neg_tx <- tx_gene_df %>%
  filter(gene_id_clean %in% neg_ctrl$gene_id_clean) %>%
  pull(transcript_id_clean)
neg_tx <- neg_tx[neg_tx %in% rownames(counts_mat0)]
cat("Negative control transcripts found in codon matrix:", length(neg_tx), "\n")
stopifnot("Fewer than 80% of neg ctrl genes found in codon matrix" =
            length(neg_tx) > 0.8 * nrow(neg_ctrl))
```

# Section 5: GC3 Content of eIF3d-Promoted Genes

GC3% is taken from `feature_matrix_te_lfc.rds`, which pre-computes it from the
same transcript selection used across all feature matrices.

```{r load_gc3}
fm_te <- readRDS(here("output", "predictive_modeling", "feature_matrix_te_lfc.rds"))
cat("Feature matrix (te_lfc):", nrow(fm_te), "genes,",
    sum(!is.na(fm_te$gc3)), "have gc3\n")

stopifnot("gc3 out of range" = all(fm_te$gc3 >= 0 & fm_te$gc3 <= 100, na.rm = TRUE))

# Biological spot-check: median GC3 across expressed genes should be in [40, 65]%
median_gc3 <- median(fm_te$gc3, na.rm = TRUE)
stopifnot("Median GC3 outside expected range [40,65]" =
            dplyr::between(median_gc3, 40, 65))
cat("Median GC3%:", round(median_gc3, 1), "(expected 40-65)\n")
```

```{r gc3_groups}
fm_gene <- fm_te %>%
  distinct(gene_id_clean, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(group = case_when(
    gene_id_clean %in% promotes$gene_id_clean ~ "eIF3d hypoxia promotes",
    TRUE ~ "All expressed"
  ))

gc3_promotes   <- fm_gene$gc3[fm_gene$group == "eIF3d hypoxia promotes"]
gc3_background <- fm_gene$gc3[fm_gene$group == "All expressed"]

n_promotes_gc3  <- sum(!is.na(gc3_promotes))
n_background_gc3 <- sum(!is.na(gc3_background))
cat("GC3 median -- promoted:", round(median(gc3_promotes, na.rm = TRUE), 1), "%",
    "| background:", round(median(gc3_background, na.rm = TRUE), 1), "%\n")

wilcox_res <- wilcox.test(gc3_promotes, gc3_background)
cat("Wilcoxon p-value (promoted vs background):", signif(wilcox_res$p.value, 3), "\n")

# Confirm promoted genes have lower GC3 (expected from nb54 AT-ending enrichment)
cat("Promoted GC3 < background median:",
    median(gc3_promotes, na.rm = TRUE) < median(gc3_background, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
```

```{r plot_gc3_density, fig.width=6, fig.height=4}
gc3_df <- fm_gene %>%
  filter(!is.na(gc3)) %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_id_clean, symbol, gc3, group) %>%
  mutate(group = factor(group, levels = c("eIF3d hypoxia promotes", "All expressed")))

group_colors_gc3 <- c(
  "eIF3d hypoxia promotes" = "#E69F00",
  "All expressed"          = "grey70"
)

wilcox_label <- paste0("Wilcoxon p = ", signif(wilcox_res$p.value, 2))

p_gc3 <- ggplot(gc3_df, aes(x = gc3, colour = group, fill = group)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.15, linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = nanoluc_gc3, linetype = "dashed",
             colour = "#0072B2", linewidth = 0.8) +
  annotate("text",
           x = nanoluc_gc3 + 1, y = Inf, vjust = 1.4, hjust = 0,
           label = paste0("NanoLuc\n", round(nanoluc_gc3, 1), "%"),
           colour = "#0072B2", size = 3.2) +
  annotate("text",
           x = Inf, y = Inf, hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.4,
           label = wilcox_label, size = 3.2) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = group_colors_gc3, name = NULL) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = group_colors_gc3, name = NULL) +
  labs(
    title    = "CDS GC3 content: eIF3d hypoxia-promoted vs all expressed (MDA-MB-231)",
    subtitle = paste0("eIF3d promotes n = ", n_promotes_gc3,
                      ", all expressed n = ", n_promotes_gc3 + n_background_gc3,
                      "; NanoLuc shown as dashed line"),
    x = "GC3% (fraction of sense codons ending in G or C)",
    y = "Density"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

print(p_gc3)
ggsave(here("plots", "64a_gc3_density_promotes_vs_background.pdf"),
       p_gc3, width = 6, height = 4)
```

---

# Section 6: Background-Corrected Pooled RSCU -- Dual Background Comparison

## 6a. Background A: Transcriptome-Wide (pre-computed)

```{r load_rscu_txwide}
rscu_txwide <- read_csv(
  here("output", "predictive_modeling", "bg_rscu_pooled_231_hyp_vs_nor.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
cat("Pooled bg-RSCU table (txwide):", nrow(rscu_txwide), "codons\n")
cat("Columns:", paste(colnames(rscu_txwide), collapse = ", "), "\n")

# Data integrity checks
stopifnot("Missing multi-synonymous codons in txwide RSCU" =
            all(multi_syn_codons %in% rscu_txwide$codon))
stopifnot("Negative bg-RSCU values (txwide)" =
            all(rscu_txwide$rscu_hyp > 0, na.rm = TRUE))

# AT-ending bias check (key finding from nb54)
rscu_txwide_multi <- rscu_txwide %>% filter(codon %in% multi_syn_codons)
at_mean <- mean(rscu_txwide_multi$rscu_hyp[rscu_txwide_multi$gc3_class == "AT-ending"], na.rm = TRUE)
gc_mean <- mean(rscu_txwide_multi$rscu_hyp[rscu_txwide_multi$gc3_class == "GC-ending"], na.rm = TRUE)
cat("Mean bg-RSCU (txwide) -- AT-ending:", round(at_mean, 3),
    "| GC-ending:", round(gc_mean, 3), "\n")
stopifnot("Expected AT-ending mean bg-RSCU > GC-ending (nb54 result)" =
            at_mean > gc_mean)

# Phe spot-check: TTT (AT) vs TTC (GC) -- TTT should have higher rscu_hyp
ttt_rscu <- rscu_txwide$rscu_hyp[rscu_txwide$codon == "TTT"]
ttc_rscu <- rscu_txwide$rscu_hyp[rscu_txwide$codon == "TTC"]
cat("Phe spot-check -- TTT (AT):", round(ttt_rscu, 3),
    "TTC (GC):", round(ttc_rscu, 3), "(expect TTT > TTC)\n")
stopifnot("TTT bg-RSCU not > TTC (Phe AT vs GC check failed)" =
            ttt_rscu > ttc_rscu)
```

## 6b. Background B: Negative Control Transcripts (recomputed)

```{r bg_props_negctrl}
neg_counts_mat <- counts_mat0[rownames(counts_mat0) %in% neg_tx, , drop = FALSE]
cat("Negative control codon matrix:", nrow(neg_counts_mat), "transcripts\n")
stopifnot("Negative control codon matrix has zero rows" = nrow(neg_counts_mat) > 0)

# Pool codon counts across negative control transcripts
neg_counts_pooled <- colSums(neg_counts_mat)
cat("Total pooled sense codons (neg ctrl background):",
    sum(neg_counts_pooled[sense_codons[sense_codons %in% names(neg_counts_pooled)]]), "\n")

# Per-AA background proportions from neg controls (length-weighted pool)
bg_props_negctrl <- imap(aa_to_codons, function(codons, aa) {
  codons   <- intersect(codons, names(neg_counts_pooled))
  if (length(codons) == 0) return(NULL)
  aa_total <- sum(neg_counts_pooled[codons])
  if (aa_total == 0) return(NULL)
  neg_counts_pooled[codons] / aa_total
})
bg_props_negctrl <- Filter(Negate(is.null), bg_props_negctrl)

# Validate: proportions sum to 1 per AA
prop_sums_nc <- sapply(bg_props_negctrl, sum)
cat("Neg-ctrl background proportions -- sum range (expect all = 1):",
    round(range(prop_sums_nc), 6), "\n")
stopifnot("Neg-ctrl background proportions do not sum to 1" =
            all(abs(prop_sums_nc - 1) < 1e-10))
cat("Background proportions computed for", length(bg_props_negctrl), "amino acids\n")
```

```{r compute_rscu_negctrl}
# Reuse compute_pooled_rscu from nb54
compute_pooled_rscu <- function(tx_ids, counts_mat, bg_props) {
  tx_ids  <- intersect(tx_ids, rownames(counts_mat))
  pooled  <- colSums(counts_mat[tx_ids, , drop = FALSE])
  rscu_vec <- set_names(rep(NA_real_, length(sense_codons)), sense_codons)
  for (aa in names(bg_props)) {
    props    <- bg_props[[aa]]
    codons   <- intersect(names(props), names(pooled))
    if (length(codons) == 0) next
    aa_total <- sum(pooled[codons])
    if (aa_total == 0) next
    bp      <- props[codons]
    valid   <- bp > 0
    if (any(valid)) {
      rscu_vec[codons[valid]] <- (pooled[codons[valid]] / aa_total) / bp[valid]
    }
  }
  rscu_vec
}

# Validate: bg-RSCU of the background against itself must equal 1
rscu_negctrl_selfcheck <- compute_pooled_rscu(neg_tx, counts_mat0, bg_props_negctrl)
rscu_nc_sense <- rscu_negctrl_selfcheck[
  sense_codons[sense_codons %in% names(rscu_negctrl_selfcheck)]]
rscu_nc_sense <- rscu_nc_sense[!is.na(rscu_nc_sense)]
cat("Self-check: neg-ctrl bg-RSCU against itself (should all = 1):",
    "min =", round(min(rscu_nc_sense), 8),
    "max =", round(max(rscu_nc_sense), 8), "\n")
stopifnot("Neg-ctrl bg-RSCU self-check failed -- background computation error" =
            all(abs(rscu_nc_sense - 1) < 1e-10))

# Now compute bg-RSCU of promoted genes vs neg-ctrl background
rscu_negctrl_vec <- compute_pooled_rscu(promotes_tx, counts_mat0, bg_props_negctrl)
cat("bg-RSCU (neg-ctrl background) range for promoted genes:",
    round(range(rscu_negctrl_vec[!is.na(rscu_negctrl_vec)]), 3), "\n")
stopifnot("Negative bg-RSCU values (neg-ctrl)" =
            all(rscu_negctrl_vec >= 0, na.rm = TRUE))

# Also validate the txwide background self-check (re-derived here)
bg_counts_pooled <- colSums(counts_mat0)
bg_props_pooled  <- imap(aa_to_codons, function(codons, aa) {
  codons   <- intersect(codons, names(bg_counts_pooled))
  if (length(codons) == 0) return(NULL)
  aa_total <- sum(bg_counts_pooled[codons])
  if (aa_total == 0) return(NULL)
  bg_counts_pooled[codons] / aa_total
}) %>% Filter(Negate(is.null), .)

rscu_txwide_selfcheck <- compute_pooled_rscu(rownames(counts_mat0), counts_mat0, bg_props_pooled)
rscu_tx_sense <- rscu_txwide_selfcheck[
  sense_codons[sense_codons %in% names(rscu_txwide_selfcheck)]]
rscu_tx_sense <- rscu_tx_sense[!is.na(rscu_tx_sense)]
cat("Self-check: txwide bg-RSCU against itself (should all = 1):",
    "min =", round(min(rscu_tx_sense), 8),
    "max =", round(max(rscu_tx_sense), 8), "\n")
stopifnot("Txwide bg-RSCU self-check failed" =
            all(abs(rscu_tx_sense - 1) < 1e-10))
```

```{r build_dual_rscu_table}
# Combine both bg-RSCU estimates into one table for comparison
rscu_dual <- tibble(
  codon         = sense_codons,
  amino_acid    = gen_code[sense_codons]
) %>%
  filter(amino_acid != "*", codon %in% multi_syn_codons) %>%
  left_join(codon_gc3_tbl %>% dplyr::select(codon, gc3_class), by = "codon") %>%
  mutate(
    rscu_txwide  = rscu_txwide$rscu_hyp[match(codon, rscu_txwide$codon)],
    rscu_negctrl = rscu_negctrl_vec[codon]
  )

stopifnot("Missing rscu_txwide values" = !any(is.na(rscu_dual$rscu_txwide)))
stopifnot("Missing rscu_negctrl values" = !any(is.na(rscu_dual$rscu_negctrl)))

# Per-AA preferred codon under each background
rscu_dual <- rscu_dual %>%
  group_by(amino_acid) %>%
  mutate(
    rank_txwide  = rank(-rscu_txwide,  ties.method = "min"),
    rank_negctrl = rank(-rscu_negctrl, ties.method = "min"),
    preferred_txwide  = rank_txwide == 1,
    preferred_negctrl = rank_negctrl == 1,
    backgrounds_agree = (rank_txwide == 1) == (rank_negctrl == 1)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Tie check
tie_check_tx <- rscu_dual %>%
  filter(preferred_txwide) %>%
  dplyr::count(amino_acid) %>%
  filter(n > 1)
tie_check_nc <- rscu_dual %>%
  filter(preferred_negctrl) %>%
  dplyr::count(amino_acid) %>%
  filter(n > 1)
if (nrow(tie_check_tx) > 0) {
  cat("WARNING: ties in txwide preferred codon for AAs:",
      paste(tie_check_tx$amino_acid, collapse = ", "), "\n")
} else {
  cat("No ties in txwide preferred codons.\n")
}
if (nrow(tie_check_nc) > 0) {
  cat("WARNING: ties in neg-ctrl preferred codon for AAs:",
      paste(tie_check_nc$amino_acid, collapse = ", "), "\n")
} else {
  cat("No ties in neg-ctrl preferred codons.\n")
}

# Agreement between backgrounds (backgrounds_agree is already in rscu_dual)
agreement_df <- rscu_dual %>%
  filter(preferred_txwide) %>%
  dplyr::select(amino_acid, codon, gc3_class, rscu_txwide, rscu_negctrl,
                preferred_txwide, preferred_negctrl, backgrounds_agree)

n_agree <- sum(agreement_df$backgrounds_agree)
n_total <- nrow(agreement_df)
cat("Preferred codon agrees between both backgrounds:",
    n_agree, "of", n_total, "amino acids\n")

if (n_agree < n_total) {
  cat("Disagreements:\n")
  print(
    rscu_dual %>%
      group_by(amino_acid) %>%
      filter(preferred_txwide != preferred_negctrl |
               (any(preferred_txwide) & any(preferred_negctrl) & !any(preferred_txwide & preferred_negctrl))) %>%
      dplyr::select(amino_acid, codon, gc3_class, rscu_txwide, rscu_negctrl,
                    preferred_txwide, preferred_negctrl) %>%
      arrange(amino_acid, desc(rscu_txwide))
  )
}
```

```{r nuc_subclass_preference, fig.width=7, fig.height=6}
# For amino acids with >2 synonymous codons: within AT-ending, is A or U favored?
# Within GC-ending, is G or C favored? Neg-ctrl background first, then txwide.

nuc_df <- rscu_dual %>%
  left_join(codon_gc3_tbl %>% dplyr::select(codon, gc3_nucleotide), by = "codon") %>%
  group_by(amino_acid) %>%
  filter(n() > 2) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    nuc_label = case_when(
      gc3_nucleotide == "A" ~ "A-ending",
      gc3_nucleotide == "T" ~ "U-ending",
      gc3_nucleotide == "G" ~ "G-ending",
      gc3_nucleotide == "C" ~ "C-ending"
    ),
    nuc_label = factor(nuc_label, levels = c("A-ending", "U-ending", "G-ending", "C-ending"))
  )

cat("Amino acids with >2 synonymous codons:", paste(sort(unique(nuc_df$amino_acid)), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Codon count:", nrow(nuc_df), "\n")

nuc_long <- nuc_df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = c(rscu_negctrl, rscu_txwide),
    names_to  = "bg_col",
    values_to = "bg_rscu"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    background = recode(bg_col,
                        rscu_negctrl = "vs. negative-control bg",
                        rscu_txwide  = "vs. transcriptome-wide bg"),
    background = factor(background,
                        levels = c("vs. negative-control bg", "vs. transcriptome-wide bg"))
  )

# Wilcoxon p-values for each gc3_class x background panel
wilcox_labels <- nuc_long %>%
  group_by(gc3_class, background) %>%
  summarise(
    p_val = wilcox.test(
      bg_rscu[nuc_label %in% c("A-ending", "G-ending")],
      bg_rscu[nuc_label %in% c("U-ending", "C-ending")]
    )$p.value,
    label = paste0("Wilcoxon p = ", signif(p_val, 2)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cat("\nWilcoxon results:\n")
print(wilcox_labels)

p_nuc <- ggplot(nuc_long, aes(x = nuc_label, y = bg_rscu, fill = gc3_class)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.5, outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.5) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 1.5, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linewidth = 0.4, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  geom_text(data = wilcox_labels,
            aes(label = label), x = Inf, y = Inf,
            hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.4, size = 3, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  facet_grid(gc3_class ~ background, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("AT-ending" = "#E69F00", "GC-ending" = "#56B4E9"),
                    guide = "none") +
  scale_x_discrete(drop = TRUE) +
  labs(
    title    = "Within-class 3rd-position nucleotide preference in eIF3d hypoxia-promoted genes",
    subtitle = "Amino acids with >2 synonymous codons only",
    x        = "3rd-position nucleotide",
    y        = "Background-corrected pooled RSCU"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))

print(p_nuc)
ggsave(here("plots", "64g_nucleotide_subclass_preference.pdf"),
       p_nuc, width = 7, height = 6)
```

# Section 7: NanoLuc Position-by-Position bg-RSCU Scoring

Score each codon position in the NanoLuc ORF by its bg-RSCU in the eIF3d
hypoxia-promoted set (transcriptome-wide background). Met (ATG) and Trp (TGG) are
excluded since they have no synonyms.

```{r nanoluc_position_scoring}
# Look up bg-RSCU for each NanoLuc codon from the txwide table
rscu_lookup_txwide <- setNames(rscu_txwide$rscu_hyp, rscu_txwide$codon)

nl_pos_df <- tibble(
  position    = seq_along(nl_codon_vec),
  codon       = nl_codon_vec,
  amino_acid  = gen_code[nl_codon_vec]
) %>%
  left_join(codon_gc3_tbl %>% dplyr::select(codon, gc3_class), by = "codon") %>%
  mutate(
    rscu_txwide = rscu_lookup_txwide[codon],
    has_synonyms = codon %in% multi_syn_codons
  )

n_scoreable <- sum(nl_pos_df$has_synonyms)
cat("NanoLuc positions scoreable (has synonyms):", n_scoreable, "of",
    nrow(nl_pos_df), "\n")
cat("Mean bg-RSCU across scoreable positions:",
    round(mean(nl_pos_df$rscu_txwide[nl_pos_df$has_synonyms], na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n")

# Codons with bg-RSCU < 0.8 are substantially sub-optimal for eIF3d-promoted genes
n_suboptimal <- sum(nl_pos_df$rscu_txwide < 0.8, na.rm = TRUE)
cat("Positions with bg-RSCU < 0.8 (sub-optimal for eIF3d):", n_suboptimal, "\n")
```

# Section 8: Design eIF3d-Adapted and Anti-Adapted NanoLuc Sequences

For each NanoLuc codon, swap to the synonymous codon with highest bg-RSCU
(3d-adapted) or lowest bg-RSCU (3d-anti-adapted) in the eIF3d hypoxia-promoted
set (transcriptome-wide background). Met/Trp positions are unchanged.

```{r build_preference_lookups}
# Per-AA preferred codon (max bg-RSCU) and anti-preferred codon (min bg-RSCU)
# Only for AAs with synonyms; use txwide bg-RSCU as ranking metric
pref_adapted <- rscu_dual %>%
  group_by(amino_acid) %>%
  slice_max(rscu_txwide, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(amino_acid, preferred_codon = codon,
                preferred_rscu = rscu_txwide, preferred_gc3 = gc3_class)

pref_antiadapted <- rscu_dual %>%
  group_by(amino_acid) %>%
  slice_min(rscu_txwide, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(amino_acid, antipreferred_codon = codon,
                antipreferred_rscu = rscu_txwide, antipreferred_gc3 = gc3_class)

pref_table <- pref_adapted %>%
  left_join(pref_antiadapted, by = "amino_acid") %>%
  mutate(aa_label = paste0(aa_three_letter[amino_acid], " (", amino_acid, ")")) %>%
  arrange(amino_acid)

cat("Preference table (", nrow(pref_table), "amino acids with synonyms):\n")
print(pref_table %>% dplyr::select(aa_label, preferred_codon, preferred_rscu,
                                   antipreferred_codon, antipreferred_rscu))

# Lookup vectors (AA → codon)
adapted_lookup     <- setNames(pref_adapted$preferred_codon, pref_adapted$amino_acid)
antiadapted_lookup <- setNames(pref_antiadapted$antipreferred_codon, pref_antiadapted$amino_acid)
```

```{r design_sequences}
design_cds <- function(codon_vec, lookup, gen_code_map) {
  aa_vec <- gen_code_map[codon_vec]
  vapply(seq_along(codon_vec), function(i) {
    aa      <- aa_vec[[i]]
    if (is.na(lookup[aa]) || is.null(lookup[aa])) return(codon_vec[i])
    lookup[[aa]]
  }, character(1))
}

adapted_codon_vec     <- design_cds(nl_codon_vec, adapted_lookup,     gen_code)
antiadapted_codon_vec <- design_cds(nl_codon_vec, antiadapted_lookup, gen_code)

adapted_cds     <- paste0(adapted_codon_vec,     collapse = "")
antiadapted_cds <- paste0(antiadapted_codon_vec, collapse = "")

# Negative control: shuffle synonymous codons within each AA type.
# Preserves codon frequencies per AA → mean bg-RSCU identical to original,
# but individual codon assignments change.
set.seed(seed)
negctrl_codon_vec <- nl_codon_vec
for (aa in multi_aa) {
  pos <- which(gen_code[nl_codon_vec] == aa)
  if (length(pos) < 2) next
  negctrl_codon_vec[pos] <- sample(nl_codon_vec[pos])
}
negctrl_cds <- paste0(negctrl_codon_vec, collapse = "")

# GC3-matched random (commented out -- not used in current design):
# if (FALSE) {
#   set.seed(seed + 1)
#   gc3rand_codon_vec <- character(length(nl_codon_vec))
#   for (i in seq_along(nl_codon_vec)) {
#     aa         <- gen_code[[nl_codon_vec[i]]]
#     syn_codons <- aa_to_codons[[aa]]
#     at_syn     <- syn_codons[substr(syn_codons, 3, 3) %in% c("A", "T")]
#     gc3rand_codon_vec[i] <- if (length(at_syn) > 0) sample(at_syn, 1) else nl_codon_vec[i]
#   }
#   gc3rand_cds <- paste0(gc3rand_codon_vec, collapse = "")
# }

cat("Original CDS length:     ", nchar(nanoluc_cds_orf), "nt\n")
cat("Adapted CDS length:      ", nchar(adapted_cds), "nt\n")
cat("Anti-adapted CDS length: ", nchar(antiadapted_cds), "nt\n")
cat("Neg-ctrl CDS length:     ", nchar(negctrl_cds), "nt\n")
```

```{r validate_designs}
# Protein identity -- any codon swap error would show up here
orig_protein    <- as.character(translate(DNAString(nanoluc_cds_orf)))
adapted_protein <- as.character(translate(DNAString(adapted_cds)))
anti_protein    <- as.character(translate(DNAString(antiadapted_cds)))

stopifnot("Adapted protein length mismatch" =
            nchar(adapted_protein) == nchar(orig_protein))
stopifnot("Anti-adapted protein length mismatch" =
            nchar(anti_protein) == nchar(orig_protein))
stopifnot("Adapted protein differs from original" =
            adapted_protein == orig_protein)
stopifnot("Anti-adapted protein differs from original" =
            anti_protein == orig_protein)
stopifnot("Adapted CDS length mismatch" =
            nchar(adapted_cds) == nchar(nanoluc_cds_orf))
stopifnot("Anti-adapted CDS length mismatch" =
            nchar(antiadapted_cds) == nchar(nanoluc_cds_orf))

negctrl_protein <- as.character(translate(DNAString(negctrl_cds)))
stopifnot("Neg-ctrl protein differs from original" =
            negctrl_protein == orig_protein)
stopifnot("Neg-ctrl CDS length mismatch" =
            nchar(negctrl_cds) == nchar(nanoluc_cds_orf))

cat("Protein identity check -- PASSED for adapted, anti-adapted, and neg-ctrl.\n")
cat("Protein (first 30 aa):", substr(orig_protein, 1, 30), "\n")

# Positions changed
n_adapted_changed     <- sum(adapted_codon_vec != nl_codon_vec)
n_antiadapted_changed <- sum(antiadapted_codon_vec != nl_codon_vec)
n_negctrl_changed     <- sum(negctrl_codon_vec != nl_codon_vec)
cat("Positions changed (adapted):     ", n_adapted_changed,
    "of", length(nl_codon_vec), "\n")
cat("Positions changed (anti-adapted):", n_antiadapted_changed,
    "of", length(nl_codon_vec), "\n")
cat("Positions changed (neg-ctrl):    ", n_negctrl_changed,
    "of", length(nl_codon_vec), "\n")
stopifnot("Neg-ctrl changed zero codons -- shuffle had no effect" =
            n_negctrl_changed > 0)

# gc3rand validation (commented out):
# gc3rand_protein   <- as.character(translate(DNAString(gc3rand_cds)))
# stopifnot("GC3-rand protein differs from original" = gc3rand_protein == orig_protein)

# stopifnot("GC3-rand changed zero codons" = n_gc3rand_changed > 0)
```

```{r design_sequences_explicit}
# Explicit codon-by-codon swap -- no function, fully transparent
adapted_codon_vec_manual     <- character(length(nl_codon_vec))
antiadapted_codon_vec_manual <- character(length(nl_codon_vec))

for (i in seq_along(nl_codon_vec)) {
  original_codon <- nl_codon_vec[i]
  aa             <- gen_code[[original_codon]]
  adapted_codon_vec_manual[i]     <- if (!is.na(adapted_lookup[aa]))
                                       adapted_lookup[[aa]] else original_codon
  antiadapted_codon_vec_manual[i] <- if (!is.na(antiadapted_lookup[aa]))
                                       antiadapted_lookup[[aa]] else original_codon
}

adapted_cds_manual     <- paste0(adapted_codon_vec_manual,     collapse = "")
antiadapted_cds_manual <- paste0(antiadapted_codon_vec_manual, collapse = "")

stopifnot("Explicit adapted CDS does not match function output" =
            adapted_cds_manual == adapted_cds)
stopifnot("Explicit anti-adapted CDS does not match function output" =
            antiadapted_cds_manual == antiadapted_cds)

# Neg-ctrl explicit loop (same shuffle, same seed)
set.seed(seed)
negctrl_codon_vec_manual <- nl_codon_vec
for (aa in multi_aa) {
  pos <- which(gen_code[nl_codon_vec] == aa)
  if (length(pos) < 2) next
  negctrl_codon_vec_manual[pos] <- sample(nl_codon_vec[pos])
}
negctrl_cds_manual <- paste0(negctrl_codon_vec_manual, collapse = "")
stopifnot("Explicit neg-ctrl CDS does not match design_sequences output" =
            negctrl_cds_manual == negctrl_cds)

cat("Explicit sequences match function output: PASSED\n\n")

cat("3d-Adapted CDS:\n", adapted_cds_manual, "\n\n")
cat("3d-Anti-adapted CDS:\n", antiadapted_cds_manual, "\n\n")
cat("3d-Neg-ctrl CDS:\n", negctrl_cds_manual, "\n")

# GC3-matched random explicit loop (commented out):
# set.seed(seed + 1)
# gc3rand_codon_vec_manual <- character(length(nl_codon_vec))
# for (i in seq_along(nl_codon_vec)) {
```

```{r density_constructs, fig.width=9, fig.height=5.5}
# Three-group gene distributions (promoted / neg-ctrl / all expressed)
# with solid vertical lines for each of the 4 NanoLuc construct variants.

fm_three <- fm_te %>%
  distinct(gene_id_clean, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(group = case_when(
    gene_id_clean %in% promotes$gene_id_clean ~ "eIF3d hypoxia promotes",
    gene_id_clean %in% neg_ctrl$gene_id_clean ~ "Negative control",
    TRUE                                       ~ "All expressed"
  ),
  group = factor(group,
                 levels = c("eIF3d hypoxia promotes", "Negative control", "All expressed")))

group_colors3 <- c(
  "eIF3d hypoxia promotes" = "#E69F00",
  "Negative control"       = "grey40",
  "All expressed"          = "grey80"
)

gc_pct_orig    <- as.numeric(letterFrequency(DNAString(nanoluc_cds_orf), "GC", as.prob = TRUE)) * 100
gc_pct_adapted <- as.numeric(letterFrequency(DNAString(adapted_cds),     "GC", as.prob = TRUE)) * 100
gc_pct_anti    <- as.numeric(letterFrequency(DNAString(antiadapted_cds), "GC", as.prob = TRUE)) * 100
gc_pct_negctrl <- as.numeric(letterFrequency(DNAString(negctrl_cds),     "GC", as.prob = TRUE)) * 100

# Colours come from construct_palette (defined with the 64f design summary), so
# a variant is the same colour in every figure here.
construct_lines <- tibble(
  variant    = factor(construct_variants, levels = construct_variants),
  cds_length = nchar(nanoluc_cds_orf) / 1000,
  gc_pct     = c(gc_pct_orig, gc_pct_adapted, gc_pct_anti, gc_pct_negctrl),
  gc3_pct    = c(nanoluc_gc3, gc3_adapted, gc3_antiadapted, gc3_negctrl),
  color      = unname(construct_palette[construct_variants])
)
construct_colors <- construct_palette[construct_variants]

cat("Construct GC% :", round(construct_lines$gc_pct, 1), "\n")
cat("Construct GC3%:", round(construct_lines$gc3_pct, 1), "\n")
cat("Construct CDS length:", construct_lines$cds_length[1], "kb (all equal)\n")

# The neg-ctrl is a within-AA synonymous shuffle of the original, so its codon
# multiset -- and therefore its GC%, GC3% and length -- is identical to Original
# NanoLuc, and all four constructs share one length. Coincident vlines are drawn
# side by side rather than stacked (see make_density below).
stopifnot("neg-ctrl GC/GC3 should equal original by construction" =
  all(abs(c(gc_pct_negctrl - gc_pct_orig, gc3_negctrl - nanoluc_gc3)) < 1e-9))
cat("Note: 3d-Neg-ctrl GC%/GC3% are identical to Original NanoLuc (synonymous",
    "shuffle preserves codon counts); the two lines are drawn adjacent.\n")

# Spread any set of constructs sharing an identical value symmetrically about
# that value, so each stays visible as its own solid line. The shift is ~one
# line width and is stated in the plot caption -- it is a drawing offset, never
# a real difference. Ties are exact here (same codon multiset), so rounding to
# 6 dp is only a float-safety net.
offset_ties <- function(df, value_col, nudge, group_cols = character(0)) {
  df %>%
    group_by(across(all_of(group_cols)), .tie = round(.data[[value_col]], 6)) %>%
    mutate(.x    = .data[[value_col]] + nudge * (dplyr::row_number() - (dplyr::n() + 1) / 2),
           .tied = dplyr::n() > 1) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::select(-.tie)
}

make_density <- function(data, x_col, vline_col, x_label, filename, xlim_range = NULL) {
  # Nudge is a fraction of the *visible* x range, so it renders the same width
  # on every panel regardless of the metric's units.
  x_span   <- if (!is.null(xlim_range)) diff(xlim_range) else
    diff(range(c(data[[x_col]], construct_lines[[vline_col]]), na.rm = TRUE))
  nudge    <- 0.006 * x_span
  lines_df <- offset_ties(construct_lines, vline_col, nudge)

  n_tied <- sum(lines_df$.tied)
  cap    <- if (n_tied > 0) {
    sprintf(paste("%d constructs have identical %s and are drawn side by side",
                  "(offset %.3g, not a real difference)"),
            n_tied, x_label, nudge)
  } else NULL

  p <- ggplot(data, aes(x = .data[[x_col]], colour = group)) +
    geom_density(linewidth = 1) +
    geom_vline(data = lines_df, aes(xintercept = .x, colour = variant),
               linewidth = 0.9) +
    # Explicit breaks so the legend keeps the groups-then-constructs order.
    scale_colour_manual(values = c(group_colors3, construct_colors),
                        breaks = c(names(group_colors3), names(construct_colors)),
                        name = NULL) +
    labs(x = x_label, y = "Density", caption = cap) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
    theme(legend.position = "right",
          axis.title   = element_text(size = 17),
          axis.text    = element_text(size = 15, colour = "black"),
          legend.text  = element_text(size = 14),
          plot.caption = element_text(size = 11, colour = "grey30", hjust = 0),
          legend.key.height = unit(1.1, "lines"))
  if (!is.null(xlim_range)) p <- p + scale_x_continuous(limits = xlim_range, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05)))
  print(p)
  ggsave(here("plots", filename), p, width = 9, height = 5.5)
}

fm_three_len <- fm_three %>% mutate(cds_length_kb = cds_length / 1000)

make_density(fm_three_len, "cds_length_kb", "cds_length", "CDS length (kb)", "64h_density_cds_length_constructs.pdf", xlim_range = c(0, 8))
make_density(fm_three,     "cds_gc",        "gc_pct",     "CDS GC%",         "64i_density_cds_gc_constructs.pdf")
make_density(fm_three,     "gc3",           "gc3_pct",    "GC3%",            "64j_density_gc3_constructs.pdf")
```

```{r nuc3_boxplot_constructs, fig.width=10, fig.height=4}
# % of all codons ending in A, U, G, or C per gene/construct, by group.

# Per-transcript percentages directly from counts_mat0
nuc3_mat <- counts_mat0[, intersect(sense_codons, colnames(counts_mat0))]
nts_cols  <- substr(colnames(nuc3_mat), 3, 3)
tx_total  <- rowSums(nuc3_mat)

nuc3_per_tx <- tibble(
  transcript_id_clean = rownames(nuc3_mat),
  total               = tx_total,
  A = rowSums(nuc3_mat[, nts_cols == "A", drop = FALSE]) / tx_total * 100,
  U = rowSums(nuc3_mat[, nts_cols == "T", drop = FALSE]) / tx_total * 100,
  G = rowSums(nuc3_mat[, nts_cols == "G", drop = FALSE]) / tx_total * 100,
  C = rowSums(nuc3_mat[, nts_cols == "C", drop = FALSE]) / tx_total * 100
)

nuc3_gene_df <- nuc3_per_tx %>%
  left_join(tx_gene_df, by = "transcript_id_clean") %>%
  mutate(group = case_when(
    transcript_id_clean %in% promotes_tx ~ "eIF3d hypoxia promotes",
    transcript_id_clean %in% neg_tx      ~ "Negative control",
    TRUE                                  ~ "All expressed"
  ),
  group = factor(group,
                 levels = c("eIF3d hypoxia promotes", "Negative control", "All expressed"))) %>%
  group_by(gene_id_clean) %>%
  slice_max(total, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(A, U, G, C),
               names_to  = "nucleotide",
               values_to = "pct") %>%
  mutate(nucleotide = factor(nucleotide, levels = c("A", "U", "G", "C")))

cat("Gene counts by group:\n")
print(nuc3_gene_df %>% distinct(gene_id_clean, group) %>% dplyr::count(group))

# Construct values
codon_vecs <- list(
  "Original NanoLuc"  = nl_codon_vec,
  "3d-Adapted"        = adapted_codon_vec,
  "3d-Anti-adapted"   = antiadapted_codon_vec,
  "3d-Neg-ctrl"       = negctrl_codon_vec
)
construct_nuc3 <- imap_dfr(codon_vecs, function(cv, nm) {
  nts <- substr(cv, 3, 3)
  n   <- length(nts)
  tibble(
    variant    = nm,
    nucleotide = c("A",  "U",  "G",  "C"),
    pct        = c(mean(nts == "A"), mean(nts == "T"),
                   mean(nts == "G"), mean(nts == "C")) * 100
  )
}) %>%
  mutate(
    variant    = factor(variant, levels = names(codon_vecs)),
    nucleotide = factor(nucleotide, levels = c("A", "U", "G", "C"))
  )

construct_nuc3_colors <- construct_palette

# The neg-ctrl is a synonymous shuffle of the original, so its 3rd-position
# nucleotide composition is identical and the two hlines coincide exactly in
# every facet. Offset ties within each facet so both stay visible (drawing
# offset only, stated in the caption).
nuc3_nudge  <- 0.01 * diff(range(nuc3_gene_df$pct, na.rm = TRUE))
nuc3_lines  <- offset_ties(construct_nuc3, "pct", nuc3_nudge, group_cols = "nucleotide")
nuc3_cap    <- if (any(nuc3_lines$.tied)) {
  sprintf(paste("Constructs with identical composition are drawn side by side",
                "(offset %.3g%%, not a real difference)"), nuc3_nudge)
} else NULL
stopifnot("neg-ctrl 3rd-position composition should equal original" =
  any(nuc3_lines$.tied))

cat("Construct 3rd-position nucleotide %:\n")
print(construct_nuc3 %>% pivot_wider(names_from = nucleotide, values_from = pct))

p_nuc3 <- ggplot(nuc3_gene_df, aes(x = group, y = pct)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.5, fill = "white") +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 0.8, alpha = 0.4, colour = "grey40") +
  geom_hline(data = nuc3_lines,
             aes(yintercept = .x, colour = variant),
             linewidth = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ nucleotide, nrow = 1) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = construct_nuc3_colors, name = "NanoLuc variant") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "% of all codons", caption = nuc3_cap) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "right",
        strip.text      = element_text(face = "bold"),
        plot.caption    = element_text(size = 9, colour = "grey30", hjust = 0),
        axis.text.x     = element_text(angle = 20, hjust = 1))

print(p_nuc3)
ggsave(here("plots", "64k_nuc3_pct_constructs.pdf"), p_nuc3, width = 10, height = 4)
```

# Section 9: GAA Codon Analysis

For each NanoLuc CDS variant, count (1) total GAA substring occurrences anywhere
in the sequence and (2) in-frame GAA codons — i.e., Glu (GAA) codons that would
occupy the ribosome A site during translation.

```{r gaa_codon_analysis}
variants <- list(
  original    = list(cds = nanoluc_cds_orf,   codons = nl_codon_vec),
  adapted     = list(cds = adapted_cds,        codons = adapted_codon_vec),
  antiadapted = list(cds = antiadapted_cds,    codons = antiadapted_codon_vec),
  negctrl     = list(cds = negctrl_cds,        codons = negctrl_codon_vec)
)

gaa_df <- imap_dfr(variants, function(v, nm) {
  tibble(
    variant        = nm,
    n_codons       = length(v$codons),
    n_gaa_total    = str_count(toupper(v$cds), "GAA"),
    n_gaa_asite    = sum(v$codons == "GAA")
  )
})

cat("GAA codon counts per NanoLuc CDS variant:\n")
cat("  n_gaa_total  = all GAA substrings in the CDS sequence (any frame)\n")
cat("  n_gaa_asite  = in-frame GAA codons (would occupy ribosome A site)\n\n")
print(gaa_df)
```
